messages:
ci-bot: :rotating_light: Build 593421 failed on main after merge — job `smoke-integration` failed. full logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/593421/jobs/smoke-integration

ashley: that's my merge (tiny docs tweak). surprised, nothing touching runtime. @leo could you eyeball the logs?

leo: looking now. can anyone kick a rerun while I pull logs?

morgan: started a rerun: `cictl rerun --job smoke-integration --build 593421` :white_check_mark:

leo: extracted error block from failing run:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory trying to allocate tensor [8,1024,2048] (requested ~28.00 GiB)
  at gpu/cuda_kernels.cu:291
  at kv_cache_allocator (inference/cache.cpp:102)
  at kv_cache_test (tests/kv_cache_test.cpp:45)
```
Node: gpu-prod-3. smells like transient mem pressure or fragmentation during kernel init.

taylor: if rerun stays red we should bisect last few merges: `git bisect start HEAD~6 HEAD` + bisect job runner. flagging @oncall-sre.

oncall-sre-bot: @oncall-sre pinged — page sent.

jessica: jessica (oncall): i'm on it. checking node metrics — gpu-prod-3 shows a big mem spike at 15:12 UTC and another pod had a runaway allocation. isolating that node and draining pods to prevent recurrence. will follow up.

morgan: rerun completed — smoke-integration passed on rerun (build 593421, rerun #1) :tada:

leo: thanks. marking as transient. i'll add a lightweight GPU free-memory gate to the smoke job (fail fast if free < 20%).

ashley: great — no revert needed. thanks folks.

jessica: incident note: type=flake, node=gpu-prod-3, action=isolated+drained, follow_up=monitor next 3 merges. closing unless it recurs.
